note: Unvocalized فرق covers فَرْق 'difference/separation', فِرَق 'teams/groups', and verbal readings such as 'separated/distinguished'. The current plural-only noun gloss is incomplete and blurs singular/plural readings.
proposed_english: difference; separation; teams; groups; separated; distinguished (depending on vocalization/use)

note: بدل also commonly means an allowance/compensation/substitute payment in modern MSA, in addition to substitute/instead of and verbal readings.
proposed_english: substitute; allowance; compensation; instead of; changed; replaced (depending on vocalization/use)

note: محافظة also commonly means preservation/maintenance/conservation, especially in المحافظة على, not only governorate/province or the feminine adjective conservative.
proposed_english: governorate; province; preservation; maintenance; conservation; conservative/preserving (feminine, depending on use)

note: خطر is also the adjective خَطِر 'dangerous' and the verb خَطَرَ 'occurred/came to mind'; these common readings are omitted.
proposed_english: danger; risk; dangerous; occurred; came to mind (depending on vocalization/use)

note: يصدق also represents يُصَدِّق 'believes; accepts as true; ratifies/confirms', a very common form omitted by the current truthfulness-only gloss.
proposed_english: is truthful; tells the truth; proves true; believes; accepts as true; confirms/ratifies (depending on vocalization/form)
